// Item 3 fixture (MATRICES § D, type Destructuration; § G, Q4). Each case is copied as a new file into a
// scanned tree of a temporary copy by tests/l0-pi-surface.test.ts.

// ── case: recepteur ──
export default function (api: any): unknown {
  const { membreDestructure } = api;
  return membreDestructure;
}

// ── case: ctx ──
export default function (api: any): void {
  api.on("turn_end", (_e: unknown, ctx: any) => {
    const { membreCtx } = ctx;
    return membreCtx;
  });
}

// ── case: reste ──
export default function (api: any): unknown {
  const { ...tout } = api;
  return tout;
}
